title: Anglo-Irish Treaty Signed
description:
The **Anglo-Irish Treaty** was signed in London on December 6, 1921, between the British government and Irish representatives. The treaty ended the Irish War of Independence and led to the establishment of the Irish Free State.

The treaty granted Ireland dominion status within the British Commonwealth, but required an oath of allegiance to the British Crown and allowed Northern Ireland to opt out, which it did. This partition remains today.

The treaty was controversial in Ireland and led to the Irish Civil War (1922-1923) between pro-treaty and anti-treaty forces. Despite this, it marked a crucial step toward Irish independence, which was fully achieved in 1949.
